occurrences.englishText: Yahweh’s* “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations. angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush. He looked, and behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.
